item.title: Antonelli tops second practice for the Qatar Grand Prix at Lusail
item.description:
Mercedes driver and world champion Kimi Antonelli topped second practice for the Qatar Formula 1 Grand Prix at Lusail International Circuit on Friday evening, ahead of team-mate George Russell and McLaren's Lando Norris. The session was extended after two red flags and ran at 8pm, the same time as Saturday evening's qualifying. Antonelli was fastest in both of the day's sessions in a Mercedes one-two, Reuters reported.
Sources: Formula1.com https://www.formula1.com/en/latest/article/fp2-antonelli-tops-extended-second-practice-from-russell-and-norris-in-qatar.6jAa2kcIAVqOPHW30oipfm · TimesLIVE (Reuters) https://www.timeslive.co.za/motoring/2026-11-27-antonelli-sets-the-pace-ahead-of-russell-in-second-qatar-grand-prix-practice/ · PlanetF1 https://www.planetf1.com/news/f1-results-qatar-grand-prix-2026-fp2-lusail

item.title: Nasser Al Attiyah wins Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge for a sixth time
item.description:
Qatar's Nasser Saleh Al Attiyah and Belgian co-driver Fabian Lurquin won the Abu Dhabi Desert Challenge for a sixth time on Friday, his third consecutive victory. Al Attiyah finished with a combined time of 12 hours, 53 minutes and 5 seconds, 2 minutes and 44 seconds ahead of France's Sébastien Loeb. American Seth Quintero finished third and was crowned World Rally-Raid Champion.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/al-attiyah-clinches-sixth-abu-dhabi-desert-challenge-title · AutoHebdo https://www.autohebdof1.com/news/other-races/rally-raid/abou-dhabi-desert-challenge-etape-5-al-attiyah-vainqueur-du-rallye-seth-quintero-champion-du-monde.html

item.title: Interior Minister oversees Qatar Grand Prix security plan
item.description:
Minister of Interior and Commander of the Internal Security Force (Lekhwiya) Sheikh Khalifa bin Hamad bin Khalifa Al Thani, chairman of the Security Committee, oversaw the security plan for the Qatar Formula 1 Grand Prix at Lusail, the Security Committee announced. He monitored security operations carried out by the participating agencies to ensure the safety of participants and spectators.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/minister-of-interior-oversees-implementation-of-formula-1-qatar-grand-prix-security-plan · Al Sharq https://al-sharq.com/article/27/11/2026/%D9%88%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%A7%D8%AE%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D9%8A%D8%B4%D8%B1%D9%81-%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%89-%D8%AA%D9%86%D9%81%D9%8A%D8%B0-%D8%AE%D8%B7%D8%A9-%D8%AA%D8%A3%D9%85%D9%8A%D9%86-%D8%B3%D8%A8%D8%A7%D9%82-%D8%AC%D8%A7%D8%A6%D8%B2%D8%A9-%D9%82%D8%B7%D8%B1-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%83%D8%A8%D8%B1%D9%89-%D9%84%D9%84%D9%81%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%85%D9%88%D9%84%D8%A7-1

item.title: Qatar and Azerbaijan hold sixth round of political consultations in Baku
item.description:
Qatar and Azerbaijan held their sixth round of political consultations in Baku on Friday, led by Minister of State for Foreign Affairs Sultan bin Saad Al Muraikhi and Azerbaijani Deputy Foreign Minister Yalchin Rafiyev. Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov received the Qatari delegation and briefed it on the priorities of Azerbaijan's 2027 chairmanship of the Organisation of Islamic Cooperation and the summit to be held in Baku.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/qatar-azerbaijan-hold-sixth-round-of-political-consultations · APA (Azerbaijan) https://en.apa.az/foreign-policy/azerbaijani-fm-jeyhun-bayramov-receives-qatari-state-minister-political-consultations-held-538992

item.title: HH the Amir offers condolences to Italy over technicians killed in Kuwait attack
item.description:
HH the Amir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad Al Thani sent a cable of condolences to Italian President Sergio Mattarella and Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni on the death of two Italian technicians in the Iranian attacks on Kuwait. The Deputy Amir Sheikh Abdullah bin Hamad Al Thani and the Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs sent similar cables.
Sources: Qatar News Agency https://qna.org.qa/en/News-Area/News/2026-11/27/hh-the-amir-sends-condolences-to-president-and-prime-minister-of-italy · Gulf Times https://www.gulf-times.com/article/739136/qatar/amir-condoles-with-president-pm-of-italy

item.title: Qatar's cochlear implant programme passes 300 cases after Kyrgyzstan mission
item.description:
Qatar's cochlear implant programme has passed 300 cases since its launch, after a medical mission to Kyrgyzstan treated 50 children with hearing impairments. The delegation performed 30 cochlear implant operations and provided 20 hearing aids in Bishkek between 6 and 10 November, supported by the Healthcare Endowment Fund of the Ministry of Awqaf and Islamic Affairs in cooperation with Hamad Medical Corporation.
Sources: The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/qatars-cochlear-implant-programme-treats-50-children-in-kyrgyzstan · Al Raya https://www.raya.com/2026/11/26/300-%D8%B9%D9%85%D9%84%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%B2%D8%B1%D8%A7%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%82%D9%88%D9%82%D8%B9%D8%A9-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D9%82%D8%B1%D8%BA%D9%8A%D8%B2%D9%8A%D8%A7

item.title: Kuwait summons Iranian ambassador and hands him a protest note
item.description:
Kuwait's Foreign Ministry on Friday summoned Iranian Ambassador Mohammad Totonji and handed him a protest note over continued Iranian attacks, most recently a drone strike on a vital site on Thursday that killed two Italians and injured a Kuwaiti and a Pakistani. Deputy Foreign Minister Hamad Al-Mashaan said Kuwait holds Iran fully responsible and reserves its right to self-defence under Article 51 of the UN Charter.
Sources: Kuwait Times (KUNA) https://kuwaittimes.com/article/54482/kuwait/kuwaits-foreign-ministry-summons-iranian-envoy-hands-him-protest-note-over-continued-iranian-attacks/ · Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/kuwait-summons-iranian-ambassador-hands-protest-note-over-deadly-drone-attack/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-tensions-trump-signals-victory-as-iran-offers-kuwait-drone-probe-1.500762639

item.title: US forces disable cargo ship that tried to breach blockade in Gulf of Oman
item.description:
US Central Command said a US military aircraft disabled the Palau-flagged cargo ship Pacific Archer in the Gulf of Oman after it left Bandar Abbas and tried to breach the naval blockade despite repeated warnings. The munitions struck the vessel's stern, disabling its propulsion without harming the crew. CENTCOM said its forces have redirected 158 commercial vessels and disabled six that refused to comply.
Sources: Arab Times https://www.arabtimesonline.com/news/us-disables-palau-flagged-cargo-ship-in-gulf-of-oman-after-blockade-warnings/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/world/mena/middle-east-tensions-trump-signals-victory-as-iran-offers-kuwait-drone-probe-1.500762639

item.title: Mecca pact states pledge to step up support for Saudi Arabia against Houthi attacks
item.description:
Pakistan and Turkey pledged to intensify support for Saudi Arabia in safeguarding its security and sovereignty at a meeting of the Mecca Joint Defence Agreement's political and defence committee in Islamabad on Friday, as the three countries condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi civilians and infrastructure. Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan said they agreed on principles for admitting new members to the pact, signed on 7 August.
Sources: Arab News Pakistan https://www.arabnews.pk/pakistan/pakistan-t%C3%BCrkiye-pledge-to-step-up-support-for-saudi-arabia-against-houthi-attacks-3008271 · Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/mecca-pact-allies-condemn-heinous-houthi-attacks-on-saudi-arabia · Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_publicaffairs/details/2026/11/27/3085536

item.title: Etihad Rail opens Liwa and Madinat Zayed stations a month early
item.description:
Sheikh Hamdan bin Zayed Al Nahyan, the Ruler's Representative in Al Dhafra Region, on Friday opened Etihad Rail's Liwa and Madinat Zayed passenger stations, which will welcome travellers from Monday 30 November, a month earlier than scheduled. The stations bring the network to six, with the Abu Dhabi to Liwa journey taking about one hour and 20 minutes and eight daily trips during the Liwa International Festival.
Sources: The National https://www.thenationalnews.com/news/uae/2026/11/27/etihad-rail-opens-two-al-dhafra-stations-ready-for-liwa-international-festival/ · Gulf News https://gulfnews.com/uae/transport/sheikh-hamdan-bin-zayed-al-nahyan-opens-two-new-etihad-rail-stations-1.500763582

item.title: Iraq raises oil exports to 3.6 million barrels per day
item.description:
Iraqi Oil Minister Basim Mohammed Khudair said the country's oil exports rose to 3.6 million barrels per day, generating $8.8 billion in October, and that Iraq is negotiating with OPEC to raise its production quota. It comes ahead of Sunday's OPEC+ meeting, which is expected to keep first-quarter 2027 output targets unchanged, according to three sources familiar with the talks.
Sources: The Peninsula (QNA) https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/27/11/2026/iraq-raises-oil-exports-to-36-million-barrels-per-day · Rallies.ai (Reuters) https://rallies.ai/news/oil-notches-first-weekly-gain-in-november-on-supply-fears-24b1b0295756c425

item.title: Solidarity Ministry: donations for Warraq victims' families exceed EGP360mn
item.description:
Solidarity Ministry spokesman Ayman Abdel Mawgoud said on Friday that donations for the families of those killed and injured in the Warraq accident exceeded EGP360 million and are still arriving from inside and outside Egypt. He said the government will hold a news conference in the middle of next week to announce the total, the donors' names and distribution rules, and will provide replacement cars to all owners of damaged vehicles.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085489 · Sada Elbalad https://www.elbalad.news/7196915

item.title: Health Minister: 31 dead in Warraq accident, 39 ambulances deployed
item.description:
Health and Population Minister Khaled Abdel Ghaffar said on Friday evening that the Warraq accident killed 31 people, the youngest an unborn child, while 26 were injured. He said 13 ambulances reached the scene within 8 minutes, rising to 39 in under 30 minutes, and that ministry consultants and university burn specialists took part in treating the injured.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085540 · The Peninsula https://thepeninsulaqatar.com/article/26/11/2026/death-toll-rises-to-31-26-injured-in-egypt-fuel-truck-fire

item.title: Marmoush and El Sayed Auto join donors for Warraq victims
item.description:
Cabinet spokesman Mohamed Adel said footballer Omar Marmoush donated to the families of those killed and injured in the Warraq accident, without disclosing the amount at his request, and that three owners of El Sayed Auto gave EGP5 million. New donations received by the cabinet on Friday totalled EGP30 million, including EGP25 million from the Khalifa Haftar Foundation for Humanitarian Work.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_egypt/details/2026/11/27/3085449 · Egyin https://www.egyin.com/article/163246/

item.title: South Sinai governor skips Christmas lights ceremony in mourning
item.description:
South Sinai Governor Ismail Mohamed Kamal declined to attend the Christmas lights festival at Soho Square in Sharm El Sheikh, scheduled for Friday, in mourning for the victims of the Ring Road accident in Warraq. The festival is held every year with thousands of tourists to mark the start of the Christmas season.
Sources: Masrawy https://www.masrawy.com/news/news_regions/details/2026/11/27/3085527 · Cairo 24 https://www.cairo24.com/2536992

item.title: Meteorology: low pressure brings rain to northern coasts from Monday
item.description:
The Egyptian Meteorological Authority warned of unstable weather from Monday 30 November as a low-pressure system lowers temperatures by up to 6 degrees, with chances of rain of varying intensity. Forecaster Manar Ghanem said Alexandria, Matrouh, Beheira, Kafr El Sheikh and Damietta will be most affected and rain may continue until the end of the week, with light rain possible on the northern coasts on Sunday.
Sources: El Watan News https://www.elwatannews.com/news/details/8405401 · Elwatan Elyoum https://elwatanelyoum.com/2026/11/%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%A3%D8%B1%D8%B5%D8%A7%D8%AF-%D8%AA%D8%B9%D9%84%D9%86-%D8%B9%D9%86-%D8%AA%D9%82%D9%84%D8%A8%D8%A7%D8%AA-%D8%AC%D9%88%D9%8A%D8%A9-%D8%AD%D8%A7%D8%AF%D8%A9-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%86%D8%AE%D9%81/

item.title: Wall Street ends week with biggest gains since 2022
item.description:
US stocks closed higher in a shortened post-Thanksgiving session on Friday, with the Dow Jones rising 1.18% to 50,774.94, the S&P 500 up 1.60% to 7,297.49 and the Nasdaq up 2.31% to 24,129.50. The Dow gained 5.46% for the week, its biggest weekly gain since October 2022, led by technology and chip stocks.
Sources: TradingKey https://www.tradingkey.com/analysis/stocks/us-stocks/262325775-nasdaq-leads-black-friday-rally-dow-posts-best-week-since-2022-tradingkey · JBizNews https://jbiznews.com/u-s-stocks-close-sharply-higher-in-shortened-black-friday-session-and-post-big-weekly-gains-dow-jones-industrial-average-up-1-18-sp-500-up-1-60-nasdaq-composite-up-2-31/

item.title: Putin commissions nuclear submarine Perm and promises five more
item.description:
Russian President Vladimir Putin on Friday attended a flag-raising ceremony aboard the Yasen-M class nuclear submarine Perm at the Sevmash shipyard in Severodvinsk, marking its entry into the navy. It is the first submarine equipped with Zircon hypersonic missiles as standard, and Putin said the navy will receive five more nuclear submarines by 2030, three of them from the same class.
Sources: Kremlin https://en.kremlin.ru/events/president/news/81370 · Gulf News (AFP) https://gulfnews.com/world/europe/vladimir-putin-unveils-nuclear-submarine-promises-five-more-by-2030-1.500763653

item.title: Canada's Supreme Court upholds Quebec's religious symbols ban
item.description:
Canada's Supreme Court on Friday largely upheld Quebec's secularism law, which bars teachers, police officers and some other public employees from wearing religious symbols at work. The National Council of Canadian Muslims called the ruling 'a dark day', while the decision could complicate Prime Minister Mark Carney's efforts to unify the country.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/canadas-top-court-largely-upholds-quebecs-religious-symbols-ban · Arab News Pakistan (Reuters) https://www.arabnews.pk/world/canadas-top-court-upholds-quebec-law-banning-religious-symbols-in-test-of-unity-3008290

item.title: Serbia's student movement nominates chemistry professor for president
item.description:
Serbia's Student List nominated Belgrade University chemistry professor Radomir Saicic for the presidential election on 27 December at a news conference in Belgrade on Friday. The movement won 140 of the 250 seats in parliament last month, and Saicic pledged to strengthen the rule of law and fight corruption.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/serbias-student-led-movement-nominates-chemistry-professor-for-presidency · Balkan Insight https://balkaninsight.com/2026/11/27/serbias-student-list-names-university-professor-as-presidential-candidate/bi/

item.title: Trump backs Iraqi prime minister's crackdown on oil smuggling
item.description:
US President Donald Trump on Friday backed Iraqi Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi's efforts to stop Iraqi oil smuggling, end corruption and bring all weapons under state control, in a post on Truth Social. He said Washington wants a united, prosperous and strong Iraq that makes its own political decisions, as the moves put Baghdad at odds with Kurdish authorities and Iran-aligned militias.
Sources: Al Jazeera English https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/11/27/trump-backs-iraqi-pms-oil-smuggling-crackdown · Asharq Al-Awsat https://english.aawsat.com/arab-world/5346286-trump-we-support-al-zaidi%E2%80%99s-efforts-assert-iraqi-state-authority

item.title: Brent posts first weekly gain of November ahead of OPEC+ meeting
item.description:
Brent crude settled at $95.44 a barrel on Friday, down 1.2%, but posted a weekly gain of about 3%, its first in November, after attacks on tankers in the Strait of Hormuz and Saudi energy facilities. US crude settled at $83.08. OPEC+ is expected to keep first-quarter 2027 output targets unchanged at its meeting on Sunday.
Sources: Rallies.ai (Reuters) https://rallies.ai/news/oil-notches-first-weekly-gain-in-november-on-supply-fears-24b1b0295756c425 · Infobae https://www.infobae.com/america/mundo/2026/11/27/el-brent-registra-una-subida-semanal-por-los-riesgos-sobre-el-suministro-mundial/
